steps.label: What it is
steps.why: A virus that can move from birds to people can spread far beyond the farms it starts in, which is why it is watched so closely.
common_mistakes: Calling it a bacterial disease. It is viral.
steps.memory_tip: Avian flu, bird flu, H5N1 — one disease, three names.
steps.margin_note: Four headings: what, how, symptoms, prevention.
lines: Avian flu is an important and dangerous
viral disease affecting poultry birds and
Bird flu is caused by the avian flu virus
H5N1. It can start a worldwide epidemic,

steps.label: How it spreads
steps.why: The virus survives on surfaces the birds have touched, so no direct contact with a bird is needed to catch it.
common_mistakes: Saying it spreads only by eating birds.
steps.memory_tip: Saliva and faeces for about ten days.
steps.margin_note: Say what carries the virus and for how long.
lines: It spreads simply by touching contaminated
Infected birds release the virus through
saliva and faeces for about 10 days.

steps.label: Symptoms
steps.why: The symptoms look like ordinary flu at first, which is why the disease is often not recognised early.
common_mistakes: Giving symptoms of a different disease.
steps.memory_tip: It starts as ordinary flu and then the breathing suffers.
steps.margin_note: List them. Each one is a tick.
lines: Humans infected by H5N1 show typical flu
like symptoms: dry cough with phlegm,
headache, sore throat and body pains.

steps.label: Prevention
steps.why: Since the virus lives in the birds, stopping an outbreak means removing the infected flock as well as protecting people.
common_mistakes: Naming a vaccine as the main prevention.
steps.memory_tip: Cook it well, cover up, cull the flock.
steps.margin_note: Three numbered measures close the answer.

insider_note: Name the virus H5N1 in the first line. A description of the illness without the causative organism is usually cut to half.
